trails.notes_en: Runs east to west, Pak Tam Chung (M001) to Tuen Mun (M200), posts every 500 m. Km, hours and star difficulty are from AFCD Enjoy Hiking (1-5 stars). Post ranges were worked out by matching AFCD's official post coordinates to AFCD's official GPX track for each stage; a boundary post may be off by one. high_point.m is the official summit height; trail_max_m is the highest point on the AFCD GPX track. Supplies are sparse on stages 1, 4, 9 and 10. In an emergency call 999 and give the nearest distance post number.
trails.notes_zh: 由東向西，北潭涌（M001）至屯門（M200），每500米一支標距柱。長度、時間及星級難度取自漁護署「郊野樂行」（1至5星）。標距柱範圍是把漁護署標距柱座標對照官方GPX路線推算，分段交界的標距柱或有一支之差。high_point.m 為官方山高，trail_max_m 為GPX路線最高點。第一、四、九及十段補給很少。遇事請致電999並報上最近的標距柱編號。

trails.notes_en: 78 km, 10 sections, Stanley Gap Road to Nam Chung. Distance posts run W001–W137 only (AFCD list), roughly every 500–650 m, not every 500 m. Harbour crossing: from W018 walk to MTR Tai Koo, Island Line to Quarry Bay, Tseung Kwan O Line to Yau Tong (Exit A1, ~1 km to W019); the official route counts the MTR ride to Lam Tin Exit A (Kwun Tong Line). Sections 3 and 8 run largely outside country parks. Section-end transport is weak at Cloudy Hill (S8/S9) and Hsien Ku Fung (S9/S10): plan descents. Emergency: 999; quote the nearest distance post.
trails.notes_zh: 全長78公里，共10段，由赤柱峽道至南涌。標距柱只有W001至W137（漁護署），間距約500–650米。過海：於W018步行往港鐵太古站，港島綫至鰂魚涌轉將軍澳綫往油塘（A1出口，步行約1公里至W019）；正式路線以藍田站A出口為第二段終點。第三、八段大部分不在郊野公園內。九龍坑山及仙姑峰均無交通接駁，須預留下山時間。緊急求助致電999，並報告最近標距柱編號。

trails.notes_en: 8 stages, The Peak to Big Wave Bay, through 5 country parks on Hong Kong Island. Distance posts H001–H100 every 500 m; H001 is on Lugard Road ~0.4 km from the start, H100 at Big Wave Bay. H068 and H084 stand at stage boundaries and appear in two stages. Post ranges checked against AFCD post grid references and AFCD GPX tracks. In an emergency call 999 and give the nearest post number. Times, lengths and difficulty are from AFCD Enjoy Hiking (hiking.gov.hk); non-summit high points are approximate, from AFCD GPX. Bus/minibus details checked against Citybus and GMB open data on 2026-09-26; always check before travel.
trails.notes_zh: 全長50公里，分8段，由山頂至大浪灣，途經港島五個郊野公園。標距柱H001至H100每500米一支；H001位於盧吉道距起點約0.4公里，H100在大浪灣。H068及H084位於段與段交界。遇緊急情況請致電999並報告最近的標距柱編號。時間、長度及難度取自漁護署「郊野樂行」。交通資料於2026年9月26日核對，出發前請再查閱。

trails.notes_en: 70 km loop from Mui Wo, 12 stages, mostly in Lantau South/North Country Parks. Distance posts every 500 m, L001 near Mui Wo to L140 back at Mui Wo (some guides call the start L000). Give your post number when calling 999. Stages 2–3 (Sunset Peak 869 m, Lantau Peak 934 m) are the hardest and most exposed. Part of Stage 7 (Yi O / Fan Lau area) is closed until further notice – check hiking.gov.hk before going. AFCD difficulty: 1★ Easy, 2★ Moderate, 3★ Demanding, 4★ Difficult. All buses are New Lantao Bus (NLB); routes 2, 4 and 21 are sparse – check nlb.com.hk timetables.
trails.notes_zh: 由梅窩出發的70公里環迴路線，共12段，主要位於南、北大嶼郊野公園。每500米一枝標距柱，由梅窩附近L001至返回梅窩的L140（部分指南稱起點為L000）。致電999求救時請報標距柱編號。第二、三段（大東山869米、鳳凰山934米）最辛苦及當風。第七段部分路段（二澳／分流一帶）封閉直至另行通知，出發前請查閱郊野樂行網站。漁護署難度：1星易行、2星普通、3星費力、4星難行。所有巴士為新大嶼山巴士；2、4及21號班次疏，請查閱時間表。

沙頭角海、南涌魚塘及紅樹林

from_end.note_zh: 先向大潭港方向步行約1公里（漁護署）。往嘉亨灣（西灣河）或赤柱。

from_end.from_en: Tai Tam Road, Tai Tam Dam (North)
from_end.from_zh: 大潭道大潭水塘大壩北面
from_end.note_en: To Chai Wan Station, or toward Stanley / Chung Hom Kok.
from_end.note_zh: 往柴灣站，或往赤柱／舂坎角。

routes.safety_en: Tai Tam Road near the exit has no pavement in places; it is narrow and busy. Take care walking to the bus stop.
routes.safety_zh: 出口大潭道部分路段無行人路，狹窄繁忙，前往車站時須小心。

highlights_en: Tai Tam Harbour views
Side trip near H075 to the Tai Tam obelisk on Obelisk Hill (~30 min)
Lan Nai Wan seaside village
highlights_zh: H075附近可上石碑山看大潭無字碑（約半小時）

high_point.name_en: Shek O Road at To Tei Wan (end)

routes.water_en: No supply on the trail. Green Power lists a store at To Tei Wan (end).
routes.water_zh: 沿途無補給。綠色力量列出終點有土地灣土多。
routes.toilets_en: Public toilets at the To Tei Wan trailhead by the bus stop (end).
routes.toilets_zh: 終點土地灣巴士站旁有公廁。
exits_en: Near Lan Nai Wan: side path up to Shek O Road (Citybus 9)
Near Tung A village: side path up to Shek O Road
exits_zh: 近爛泥灣：支路上石澳道（城巴9號）
近東丫村：支路上石澳道

to_start.note_en: Alight Tai Tam Reservoir (North); walk ~30 m toward Tai Tam Harbour, down the stairs, then ~1 km toward Shek O to the start (AFCD).
to_start.note_zh: 於「大潭水塘（北）」站下車，向大潭港方向步行約30米落樓梯，再往石澳方向步行約1公里至起點（漁護署）。

to_start.note_en: Alight Tai Tam Road, Tai Tam Dam (North).
to_start.note_zh: 於大潭道大潭水塘大壩北面下車。

from_end.from_en: To Tei Wan, Shek O Road
from_end.note_en: To Shau Kei Wan MTR (cross road); same-side stop goes to Shek O.
from_end.note_zh: 過對面往筲箕灣港鐵站；同側往石澳。

from_end.from_en: To Tei Wan, Shek O Road
from_end.note_en: Express to Central (Star Ferry); weekends and public holidays.
from_end.note_zh: 特快往中環（天星碼頭）；週末及公眾假期。

from_end.from_en: To Tei Wan, Shek O Road
from_end.note_en: Red minibus, hail-and-ride, to Shau Kei Wan MTR.
from_end.note_zh: 紅色小巴，揚手即停，往筲箕灣港鐵站。

routes.safety_en: Short roadside walk from the bus stop to the start. Long catchwater; ends with a tiring ~400 m flight of concrete steps up to Shek O Road.
routes.safety_zh: 由巴士站到起點需走一小段馬路。引水道路段長；終點需登約400米水泥梯級上石澳道，頗費力。

highlights_en: Dragon's Back ridge
Shek O Peak views of Shek O, Stanley and Tai Tam Bay
Finish at Big Wave Bay beach (H100)
highlights_zh: 打爛埕頂山遠眺石澳、赤柱及大潭灣
於大浪灣沙灘完成全程（H100）
routes.water_en: None on the trail; bring all water. Store at To Tei Wan (start). Cafés, restaurants and stores at Big Wave Bay (end).
routes.water_zh: 沿途無補給，須自備足夠食水。起點土地灣有土多；終點大浪灣有餐廳、咖啡店及士多。
routes.toilets_en: Public toilets at To Tei Wan trailhead (start). Beach toilets, changing rooms and showers at Big Wave Bay (end). None on the ridge.
routes.toilets_zh: 起點土地灣有公廁；終點大浪灣泳灘有廁所、更衣室及淋浴。山脊上無廁所。
exits_en: After the ridge: left back along the early Dragon's Back path to To Tei Wan (mountain-bike trail, beware bikes)
On the concrete road: turn left down to Shek O Road
Junction to Tai Tam Gap
Ma Tong O: down past Cape Collinson cemeteries to Chai Wan (Wan Tsui Estate)
exits_zh: 落龍脊後分支：左走龍脊初段返土地灣（越野單車徑，小心單車）
接水泥路後：左走落石澳道
往大潭峽分岔口
馬塘坳：經歌連臣角墳場下至柴灣環翠邨

to_start.from_en: Shau Kei Wan Bus Terminus (MTR Shau Kei Wan, Exit A)
to_start.from_zh: 筲箕灣巴士總站（港鐵筲箕灣站A出口）
to_start.note_en: Citybus toward Shek O; alight To Tei Wan. Trailhead is beside the stop.
to_start.note_zh: 城巴往石澳，於「土地灣」站下車，起點在車站旁。

to_start.from_en: Near MTR Shau Kei Wan (Perfect Mount Gardens terminus)
to_start.from_zh: 筲箕灣港鐵站附近（峻峰花園小巴站）
to_start.note_en: Red minibus; tell the driver 'To Tei Wan' (土地灣).
to_start.note_zh: 紅色小巴，上車告知司機在土地灣落車。

from_end.route: Big Wave Bay – Shau Kei Wan
from_end.note_en: Red minibus starts at Big Wave Bay; runs about 09:30–22:50 (Sun/PH from 08:30). Leaves when full; carry cash.
from_end.note_zh: 紅色小巴由大浪灣開出，約09:30至22:50（週日及假期08:30起），滿座即開，請備現金。

from_end.from_en: Big Wave Bay Road / Shek O Road
from_end.note_en: Only a few trips call at Big Wave Bay itself; otherwise walk ~1 km up Big Wave Bay Road to Shek O Road and take Citybus 9 to Shau Kei Wan MTR.
from_end.note_zh: 只有少數班次進入大浪灣站；一般需沿大浪灣道步行約1公里至石澳道，乘城巴9號往筲箕灣港鐵站。

routes.safety_en: Exposed ridge with little shade: heat and sun risk in summer. Steep climb for the first ~1.5 km. Very crowded on weekends. Parts are shared with mountain bikes.
routes.safety_zh: 山脊開揚少遮蔭，夏天慎防中暑及曬傷。首約1.5公里上斜。週末人多。部分路段與越野單車共用。

highlights_en: Views over Mui Wo's five villages
Shaded road-side path
Nam Shan barbecue area
routes.water_en: Buy supplies in Mui Wo (shops, restaurants). Nothing en route. Tap water at Nam Shan campsite.
routes.water_zh: 在梅窩購買補給（商店、餐廳）。沿途無補給。南山營地有自來水。
routes.toilets_en: Mui Wo Ferry Pier; flushing toilets at Nam Shan.
routes.toilets_zh: 梅窩碼頭；南山有沖水廁所。
exits_en: Short stage beside South Lantau Road – bus stops nearby
exits_zh: 全段貼近嶼南道，附近有巴士站

to_start.note_en: Sun Ferry; about every 30–50 min, ~35–55 min trip. Get off at Mui Wo Ferry Pier.
to_start.note_zh: 新渡輪；約30–50分鐘一班，航程約35–55分鐘，於梅窩碼頭下船。

to_start.from_en: Tung Chung Station Bus Terminus (MTR Tung Chung)
to_start.from_zh: 東涌站巴士總站（港鐵東涌站）
to_start.note_en: Frequent (about every 15–25 min).
to_start.note_zh: 班次頻密（約15–25分鐘一班）。

to_start.note_en: Blue Lantau taxis only; may need to wait.
to_start.note_zh: 只有藍色大嶼山的士，或需等候。

from_end.note_en: Towards Mui Wo: 1, 2, 3M, 4. Towards Tung Chung: 3M. Route 1 (Tai O) and 2 (Ngong Ping) go west.
from_end.note_zh: 往梅窩：1、2、3M、4；往東涌：3M。1號往大澳、2號往昂坪。

routes.safety_en: Mostly along road with traffic. Stock up in Mui Wo before stage 2.
routes.safety_zh: 大部分沿車路，小心車輛。第二段前先在梅窩備足物資。

highlights_en: Sunset Peak silvergrass (autumn)
1920s stone cabins of Lantau Mountain Camp
Views of Cheung Sha Beach
routes.water_en: None on trail. Carry all water; any stream water must be treated.
routes.water_zh: 沿途無補給，須帶足食水；溪水須處理後才飲用。
routes.toilets_en: Nam Shan (start) and Pak Kung Au (end, AFCD flushing toilet). None on trail.
routes.toilets_zh: 南山（起點）及伯公坳（終點，漁護署沖水廁所）。沿途沒有。
exits_en: Side paths on the left soon after Nam Shan lead down to South Lantau Road
exits_zh: 離開南山不久，左方有支路可落嶼南道

to_start.from_en: Mui Wo Ferry Pier (1, 2, 4) / Tung Chung Station (3M)
to_start.note_en: Alight at 'Nam Shan Camp Site' stop on South Lantau Road. 3M is the most frequent; 2 and 4 are sparse.
to_start.note_zh: 於嶼南道「南山營地」站下車。3M最頻密；2及4號班次疏。

from_end.note_en: Tung Chung side: 3M, 11, 23. Mui Wo side: 3M. Stops on both sides of the road.
from_end.note_zh: 往東涌：3M、11、23；往梅窩：3M。路兩旁均有車站。

routes.safety_en: Big climbs and descents; almost no shade; exposed to wind, fog and lightning. Avoid in heat, thunderstorms or strong wind.
routes.safety_zh: 大上大落；幾乎無遮蔭；山頂當風，易起霧及受雷暴影響。酷熱、雷暴或大風時避免前往。

highlights_en: Lantau Peak summit (934 m)
Sunrise and sea-of-cloud views
Steep 'Staircase to the Sky' down to Ngong Ping
routes.water_en: None on trail. Shops and restaurants at Ngong Ping Village at the end.
routes.water_zh: 沿途無補給。終點昂坪市集有商店及餐廳。
routes.toilets_en: Pak Kung Au (start) and Ngong Ping (end). None on trail.
routes.toilets_zh: 伯公坳（起點）及昂坪（終點）。沿途沒有。
exits_en: At post L020, turn left onto South Lantau Country Trail back to Pak Kung Au
exits_zh: 於標距柱L020左轉，經南大嶼郊遊徑返回伯公坳

to_start.from_en: Tung Chung Station (3M, 11) / Tung Chung Tat Tung Road (23) / Mui Wo (3M)
to_start.from_zh: 東涌站（3M、11）／東涌達東路（23）／梅窩（3M）
to_start.note_en: Alight at 'Pak Kung Au' stop on Tung Chung Road. 3M and 11 are frequent.
to_start.note_zh: 於東涌道「伯公坳」站下車。3M及11號班次頻密。

from_end.note_en: To Tung Chung; last bus 19:10.
from_end.note_zh: 往東涌；尾班19:10。

from_end.note_en: To Mui Wo; sparse. Last 19:05 Mon–Fri, 18:10 Sat, 18:45 Sun/PH.
from_end.note_zh: 往梅窩；班次疏。尾班：平日19:05、星期六18:10、日/假期18:45。

from_end.note_en: To Tai O; about hourly, last ~18:15–18:30.
from_end.note_zh: 往大澳；約每小時一班，尾班約18:15–18:30。

from_end.note_en: To Tung Chung (~25 min). Closes 18:00 weekdays, 18:30 weekends/PH.
from_end.note_zh: 往東涌（約25分鐘）。平日18:00、週末及假期18:30關閉。

from_end.note_en: Blue Lantau taxis; may need to wait.
from_end.note_zh: 藍色大嶼山的士，或需等候。

routes.safety_en: Very steep stone steps, ~630 m climb; exposed summit with strong wind, fog, cold in winter. Descent is steep and rocky. Pre-dawn hikers need torches.
routes.safety_zh: 石級非常陡峭，爬升約630米；山頂當風，多霧，冬季寒冷。落山路段陡峭多石。摸黑上山看日出須帶電筒。

highlights_en: Wisdom Path (Heart Sutra wooden pillars)
Views of Lantau Peak range
Shek Pik Reservoir
routes.water_en: Ngong Ping Village at the start. Nothing after.
routes.water_zh: 起點昂坪市集可補給，之後沒有。
routes.toilets_en: Ngong Ping (start). None after.
routes.toilets_zh: 昂坪（起點）。之後沒有。
exits_en: Near start: back to Ngong Ping bus terminus
Part of the route follows Ngong Ping Road
exits_zh: 近起點：返回昂坪巴士總站
部分路段沿昂坪路

to_start.from_en: Tung Chung Tat Tung Road Bus Terminus
to_start.note_en: About every 20–30 min (Mon–Sat 07:15–18:10).
Sparse: Mon–Fri only 5 trips (11:00–17:00); hourly Sat and Sun/PH.
to_start.note_zh: 班次疏：星期一至五只有5班（11:00–17:00）；星期六及日/假期每小時一班。

to_start.note_en: About hourly; last from Tai O ~16:45 Mon–Fri, 17:45 Sat/Sun.
to_start.note_zh: 約每小時一班；大澳尾班約16:45（平日）、17:45（週末）。

to_start.from_en: Tung Chung Cable Car Terminal (near MTR Tung Chung)
to_start.from_zh: 東涌纜車站（近港鐵東涌站）
to_start.note_en: About 25 min. 10:00–18:00 weekdays, 09:00–18:30 weekends/PH.

from_end.from_en: Sham Wat Road / Sham Wat Road Junction stops
from_end.note_en: To Mui Wo: 1, 2. To Tung Chung: 11, 23. To Tai O: 1, 11, 21. To Ngong Ping: 2, 21, 23.

routes.safety_en: Easy; watch for traffic on road sections. Route was realigned in 2008 after landslides – follow signs.
routes.safety_zh: 容易；車路段注意車輛。2008年山泥傾瀉後改道，請跟隨路牌。

highlights_en: Kwun Yam Temple (1910)
Keung Shan and Ling Wui Shan ridge
Man Cheung Po waterfalls
routes.water_en: None. Seasonal stream at Man Cheung Po campsite (treat before drinking).
routes.water_zh: 沒有補給。萬丈布營地有季節性溪水（須處理）。
routes.toilets_en: None on trail. Dry pit toilet at Man Cheung Po campsite.
routes.toilets_zh: 沿途沒有。萬丈布營地有旱廁。
exits_en: After Keung Shan: branch right to Lung Tsai Ng Yuen
Keung Shan Country Trail down towards Keung Shan / Tai O Road
exits_zh: 過羗山後右轉支路往龍仔悟園
羗山郊遊徑落羗山道／大澳道

to_start.from_en: Mui Wo (1, 2) / Tung Chung (11, 23) / Tai O or Ngong Ping (21)
to_start.note_en: Alight at 'Sham Wat Road' (1, 11) or the nearby 'Sham Wat Road Junction' (2, 23). Start is at the pavilion at Sham Wat Rd / Keung Shan Rd junction.
to_start.note_zh: 於「深屈道」（1、11）或附近「深屈道口」（2、23）下車。起點在深屈道與羗山道交界涼亭。

from_end.from_en: Lung Chai (龍仔) stop, Keung Shan / Tai O Road
from_end.note_en: Walk down from Lung Tsai Ng Yuen along Keung Shan Catchwater. 1 to Mui Wo, 11 to Tung Chung, 21 to Ngong Ping; all also go to Tai O.
from_end.note_zh: 由龍仔悟園沿羗山引水道落山。1號往梅窩、11號往東涌、21號往昂坪；亦可往大澳。

routes.safety_en: Sustained climbs to Keung Shan/Ling Wui Shan with little shade. Lung Tsai Ng Yuen is private – do not climb on the zig-zag bridge stones.
routes.safety_zh: 上羗山及靈會山長斜，少遮蔭。龍仔悟園屬私人地方，勿倚坐九曲橋石塊。

highlights_en: Lung Tsai Ng Yuen garden
Panorama of Tai O from Nan Yam Ting pavilion
Old stone path and Nam Chung Village
routes.water_en: None until Tai O (many shops and restaurants).
routes.water_zh: 到大澳才有補給（大量商店及食肆）。
routes.toilets_en: Dry pit at Man Cheung Po campsite; public toilets in Tai O.
routes.toilets_zh: 萬丈布營地旱廁；大澳有公廁。
exits_en: Near L051: Keung Shan Country Trail / catchwater down to Lung Chai bus stop
exits_zh: 標距柱L051附近：經羗山郊遊徑／引水道落龍仔巴士站

to_start.note_en: Alight at 'Lung Chai'. Walk up Keung Shan Catchwater to Ng Yuen, then along the trail to Man Cheung Po.
to_start.note_zh: 於「龍仔」站下車，沿羗山引水道上悟園，再沿鳳凰徑往萬丈布。

from_end.note_en: 11 to Tung Chung (frequent, till after midnight); 1 to Mui Wo; 21 to Ngong Ping (about hourly, last ~17:45).
from_end.note_zh: 11號往東涌（頻密，服務至午夜後）；1號往梅窩；21號往昂坪（約每小時，尾班約17:45）。

from_end.route: Tai O–Sha Lo Wan–Tung Chung–Tuen Mun
from_end.note_en: Fortune Ferry; few sailings – check timetable.
from_end.note_zh: 富裕小輪；班次少，出發前查閱船期。

from_end.note_en: Blue Lantau taxis at Tai O.
from_end.note_zh: 大澳有藍色大嶼山的士。

routes.safety_en: Very steep stone-step descent to Tai O; mossy and slippery when wet. Use handrails.
routes.safety_zh: 落大澳石級非常陡峭，有青苔，雨天濕滑，請扶欄杆。

highlights_en: Yi O mangroves and farmland
Fan Lau Fort and Pearl River estuary 'two-colour' water
Chicken Wing (Kai Yet Kok) and remote beaches
highlights_zh: 分流炮台及珠江口「鴛鴦水」
routes.water_en: Tai O at start. Small store in Fan Lau village (irregular hours). Seasonal streams at campsites.
routes.water_zh: 起點大澳補給。分流村有小士多（營業時間不定）。營地有季節性溪水。
routes.toilets_en: Tai O (start). Dry pit toilet at Kau Ling Chung campsite.
routes.toilets_zh: 大澳（起點）。狗嶺涌營地有旱廁。
exits_en: No road exits – turn back to Tai O, or continue to Kau Ling Chung then ~1 hr catchwater walk to Shek Pik
exits_zh: 沒有車路出口：折返大澳，或繼續到狗嶺涌再沿引水道步行約1小時到石壁

to_start.from_en: Mui Wo (1) / Tung Chung Station (11) / Ngong Ping (21)
to_start.note_en: 11 is frequent (about every 15–25 min); 1 about every 30–45 min; 21 about hourly.
to_start.note_zh: 11號頻密（約15–25分鐘）；1號約30–45分鐘；21號約每小時一班。

to_start.route: Tuen Mun–Tung Chung–Sha Lo Wan–Tai O
to_start.note_en: Fortune Ferry; few sailings a day – check timetable.
to_start.note_zh: 富裕小輪；每日班次少，出發前查閱船期。

from_end.from_en: Sha Tsui stop (Shek Pik dam, South Lantau Road)
from_end.from_zh: 沙咀站（石壁水塘壩，嶼南道）
from_end.note_en: Towards Tung Chung: 11, 23. Towards Mui Wo: 1, 2. Towards Tai O/Ngong Ping: 1, 11 / 2, 23.

routes.safety_en: PART CLOSED until further notice (AFCD): landslides (notice 10 Oct 2025) and private-land farming at Yi O villages – follow site diversions. Fan Lau Country Trail, Kau Ling Chung–Fan Shui Au and Tsin Yue Wan campsite also closed. Remote, no exits; overgrown in places. Allow extra ~1 hr to reach buses.
routes.safety_zh: 部分路段封閉直至另行通知（漁護署）：山泥傾瀉（2025年10月10日通告）及二澳村私人土地復耕，請按現場改道指示。分流郊遊徑、狗嶺涌至分水坳及煎魚灣營地亦封閉。路段偏遠無出口，部分草叢茂密。到車站須另加約1小時。

highlights_en: Lantau South Obelisk (1902)
Views of Soko Islands
Shek Pik Hung Hau Ancient Temple
routes.water_en: No shops. Seasonal streams at Kau Ling Chung and Tai Long Wan campsites. Tap at toilets near Shek Pik (Wang Pui Road entrance).
routes.water_zh: 沒有商店。狗嶺涌及大浪灣營地有季節性溪水。石壁宏貝道入口附近廁所有水。
routes.toilets_en: Dry pits at Kau Ling Chung and Tai Long Wan campsites; flushing toilets near Wang Pui Road entrance, Shek Pik.
routes.toilets_zh: 狗嶺涌及大浪灣營地旱廁；石壁宏貝道入口附近有沖水廁所。
exits_en: None mid-stage; the stage ends at the nearest road (Shek Pik)
exits_zh: 中途沒有出口，終點石壁為最近車路

to_start.note_en: No road to Kau Ling Chung: alight at 'Sha Tsui' and walk ~1 hr along the catchwater.
to_start.note_zh: 狗嶺涌不通車：於「沙咀」站下車，沿引水道步行約1小時。

from_end.from_en: Sha Tsui stop (Shek Pik dam, South Lantau Road)
from_end.from_zh: 沙咀站（石壁水塘壩，嶼南道）
from_end.note_en: Towards Tung Chung: 11, 23. Towards Mui Wo: 1, 2. Towards Tai O/Ngong Ping: 1, 11 / 2, 23.

routes.safety_en: Mostly concrete catchwater, easy but long and remote. Carry enough water.
routes.safety_zh: 大部分為引水道石屎路，容易但偏遠路長，須帶足水。

highlights_en: Shek Pik Reservoir dam and viewing platform
Shek Pik rock carving (~3,000 years old)
Shek Lam Chau and Lo Kei Wan beaches
highlights_zh: 石壁水塘主壩及觀景台
routes.water_en: None until Shui Hau (village store). Seasonal streams at Shek Lam Chau (L092) and Lo Kei Wan campsites.
routes.water_zh: 到水口村才有士多。石欖洲（L092）及籮箕灣營地有季節性溪水。
routes.toilets_en: Near Shek Pik (start); dry pits at Shek Lam Chau and Lo Kei Wan campsites.
routes.toilets_zh: 石壁附近（起點）；石欖洲及籮箕灣營地有旱廁。
exits_en: No easy exits – continue to Shui Hau or return to Shek Pik
exits_zh: 沒有方便出口：繼續往水口或折返石壁

to_start.from_en: Sha Tsui stop (Shek Pik dam, South Lantau Road)
to_start.from_zh: 沙咀站（石壁水塘壩，嶼南道）
to_start.note_en: From Mui Wo: 1, 2. From Tung Chung: 11, 23.

from_end.note_en: Towards Mui Wo: 1, 2. Towards Tung Chung: 11, 23.

routes.safety_en: Gentle coastal path. Shek Pik Country Trail (links Shek Lam Chau) closed since 24 Jul 2026 – do not use it as a shortcut.
routes.safety_zh: 平緩海岸路。石壁郊遊徑（連接石欖洲）自2026年7月24日起封閉，切勿取道。

routes.end_en: Cheung Sha (post L113, Tung Chung Road)
highlights_en: Shui Hau mudflat (horseshoe crabs at low tide)
Views of Tong Fuk and Cheung Sha beaches
Shaded catchwater walk
highlights_zh: 水口泥灘（潮退可見馬蹄蟹）
routes.water_en: Shui Hau village at start. None on trail; Tong Fuk/Cheung Sha shops need a detour to South Lantau Road.
routes.water_zh: 起點水口村可補給。沿途沒有；塘福／長沙商店須繞落嶼南道。
routes.toilets_en: None on trail.
routes.toilets_zh: 沿途沒有。
exits_en: Vehicle track near Ma Po Ping / Tong Fuk prison down to South Lantau Road
At L113: right, ~20 min down to Cheung Sha Bridge bus stop
exits_zh: 近麻埔坪／塘福懲教所車路落嶼南道
L113右轉，約20分鐘落長沙大橋巴士站

to_start.note_en: From Mui Wo: 1, 2. From Tung Chung: 11, 23. Walk ~2 min along South Lantau Road to the start.
to_start.note_zh: 梅窩開：1、2；東涌開：11、23。下車後沿嶼南道步行約2分鐘到起點。

from_end.from_en: Cheung Sha Bridge stop, South Lantau Road
from_end.note_en: From post L113 turn right and walk ~20 min down to South Lantau Road. To Mui Wo: 1, 2, 4. To Tung Chung: 11, 23.
from_end.note_zh: 由標距柱L113右轉步行約20分鐘落嶼南道。往梅窩：1、2、4；往東涌：11、23。

routes.safety_en: Uphill start; watch for mountain bikers on shared sections. Stage end is up on the hillside, ~20 min from the bus.
routes.safety_zh: 起步上斜；共用路段留意越野單車。終點在山腰，距巴士站約20分鐘。

routes.start_en: Cheung Sha (post L113, Tung Chung Road)
highlights_en: Shaded woodland with streams
Views of Pui O Bay, Chi Ma Wan and Shek Kwu Chau
Pui O Beach
highlights_zh: 遠眺貝澳灣、芝麻灣及石鼓洲
routes.water_en: None on trail. Shops and cafés at Pui O village and beach.
routes.water_zh: 沿途沒有。貝澳村及海灘有商店及餐廳。
routes.toilets_en: None on trail; at Pui O Beach (end).
routes.toilets_zh: 沿途沒有；終點貝澳泳灘有。
exits_en: Near start: steps up to Tung Chung Road (ask driver for stop)
exits_zh: 近起點：石級上東涌道（先向司機查詢車站）

to_start.from_en: Cheung Sha Bridge stop, South Lantau Road
to_start.note_en: Walk ~50 m to a pavilion, turn left, ~20 min up to post L113.
to_start.note_zh: 下車後沿嶼南道行約50米至涼亭，左轉步行約20分鐘到標距柱L113。

from_end.from_en: Lo Uk Tsuen stop, South Lantau Road (Pui O)
from_end.note_en: About 1 min walk from trail end. To Mui Wo: 1, 2, 3M, 4. To Tung Chung: 3M.
from_end.note_zh: 終點步行約1分鐘。往梅窩：1、2、3M、4；往東涌：3M。

routes.safety_en: Easiest stage. Final stone-step descent to Shui Nam Road/Pui O can be slippery.
routes.safety_zh: 最易行的一段。最後落水南路／貝澳的石級或濕滑。

highlights_en: Feral water buffalo at Pui O
Views of Pui O Wan and Chi Ma Wan
Silver Mine Bay and old mining area
routes.water_en: Pui O at start. Seasonal stream at Pak Fu Tin campsite (L132). Shops and restaurants in Mui Wo.
routes.water_zh: 起點貝澳補給。白富田營地（L132）有季節性溪水。梅窩有商店及食肆。
routes.toilets_en: Pui O (start); dry pit at Pak Fu Tin campsite; Mui Wo Ferry Pier (end).
routes.toilets_zh: 貝澳（起點）；白富田營地旱廁；梅窩碼頭（終點）。
exits_en: At L130: turn left on side path to South Lantau Road
After Pak Fu Tin, on reaching the road turn left to South Lantau Road
exits_zh: 標距柱L130左轉支路往嶼南道
過白富田接上馬路後左轉往嶼南道

to_start.from_en: Lo Uk Tsuen stop, South Lantau Road (Pui O)
to_start.note_en: From Mui Wo: 1, 2, 3M, 4. From Tung Chung Station: 3M.
to_start.note_zh: 梅窩開：1、2、3M、4；東涌站開：3M。

from_end.note_en: Sun Ferry to Central Pier 6; about every 30–50 min until late night.
from_end.note_zh: 新渡輪往中環6號碼頭；約30–50分鐘一班，服務至深夜。

from_end.note_en: To Tung Chung Station; frequent (about every 15–25 min).
from_end.note_zh: 往東涌站；班次頻密（約15–25分鐘一班）。

from_end.note_en: Blue Lantau taxis only; may need to wait.
from_end.note_zh: 只有藍色大嶼山的士，或需等候。

routes.safety_en: Several climbs in forest. A section of the Mui Wo–Pui O Mountain Bike Trail is closed (since 30 Jun 2026) – follow on-site signs.
routes.safety_zh: 林中有數段上斜。梅窩至貝澳越野單車徑部分路段自2026年6月30日起封閉，請留意現場指示。

highlights_en: Hung Shing Yeh Beach
Hilltop pavilion views over the island and power station
Kamikaze Caves (WWII) near Sok Kwu Wan
highlights_zh: 山頂涼亭飽覽海島及發電廠景色
索罟灣附近的神風洞（二戰遺跡）
routes.water_en: Shops and restaurants at Yung Shue Wan, Hung Shing Yeh Beach, Lo So Shing and Sok Kwu Wan.
routes.water_zh: 榕樹灣、洪聖爺灣、蘆鬚城及索罟灣均有士多及食肆。
routes.toilets_en: Yung Shue Wan Main Street, Hung Shing Yeh Beach, Lo So Shing, Sok Kwu Wan pier.
routes.toilets_zh: 榕樹灣大街、洪聖爺灣泳灘、蘆鬚城、索罟灣碼頭。
exits_en: Turn back to Yung Shue Wan
Side path down to Lo So Shing Beach
exits_zh: 折返榕樹灣
支路下往蘆鬚城泳灘

to_start.note_en: HKKF, about 27 min. About every 30 min on Sun/PH; 20–60 min Mon–Sat.
to_start.note_zh: 港九小輪，約27分鐘。星期日及假日約30分鐘一班；平日約20至60分鐘一班。

to_start.route: Aberdeen – Pak Kok Tsuen – Yung Shue Wan
to_start.note_en: Tsui Wah Ferry, about 11 sailings a day.
to_start.note_zh: 翠華船務，每日約11班。

from_end.note_en: HKKF to Central Pier 4, 30–40 min. Only about every 1–2 hours; extra sailings Sun/PH if busy. Check times.
from_end.note_zh: 港九小輪往中環4號碼頭，約30至40分鐘。約1至2小時一班，星期日及假日視乎人流加班。出發前查船期。

from_end.route: Sok Kwu Wan – Mo Tat – Aberdeen
from_end.note_en: Chuen Kee Ferry, about 35 min.
from_end.note_zh: 全記渡，約35分鐘。

routes.safety_en: Sok Kwu Wan has far fewer ferries than Yung Shue Wan. Check the return time, or walk the other way and finish at Yung Shue Wan.
routes.safety_zh: 索罟灣船班比榕樹灣少得多，請先查回程船期，或反方向走，以榕樹灣作終點。

routes.name_en: Tai Tam Reservoirs (Tai Tam Waterworks Heritage Trail)
routes.name_zh: 大潭水塘（大潭水務文物徑）
routes.start_en: Tai Tam Reservoir Road, Wong Nai Chung Gap
routes.end_en: Tai Tam Road (Tai Tam Tuk Reservoir)
highlights_en: Victorian dams, valve houses and granite arch bridges (declared monuments)
Four reservoirs: Upper, Byewash, Intermediate, Tai Tam Tuk
Optional Tai Tam Family Walk (1.6 km) to Tai Tam Viewing Point
highlights_zh: 維多利亞時期水壩、水掣房及麻石拱橋（法定古蹟）
四個水塘：大潭上、副、中水塘及大潭篤水塘
可加走大潭家樂徑（1.6公里）往大潭觀景台
routes.water_en: No shops on the route. Water filling station and drinking fountain at a road junction along the way. Bring water.
routes.water_zh: 沿途沒有商店。途中路口設加水站及飲水機。請自備食水。
routes.toilets_en: Public toilets and pavilions along Tai Tam Reservoir Road.
routes.toilets_zh: 大潭水塘道沿途設公廁及涼亭。
exits_en: Walk back up Tai Tam Reservoir Road to Wong Nai Chung Gap
exits_zh: 沿大潭水塘道折返黃泥涌峽

to_start.note_en: Alight Wong Nai Chung Reservoir Park stop. Walk up Tai Tam Reservoir Road.
to_start.note_zh: 於黃泥涌水塘公園站下車，沿大潭水塘道上行。

to_start.note_en: Same stops at Wong Nai Chung Gap.
to_start.note_zh: 同樣在黃泥涌峽一帶下車。

to_start.note_en: Alight Tai Tam Reservoir Road / Wong Nai Chung Gap Road.
to_start.note_zh: 於大潭水塘道／黃泥涌峽道下車。

to_start.note_en: Can drop you at the Tai Tam Reservoir Road barrier near Parkview, saving about 20 min uphill.
to_start.note_zh: 可乘的士到陽明山莊附近的大潭水塘道車閘，省去約20分鐘上坡。

from_end.note_en: To Sai Wan Ho, or to Stanley.
from_end.note_zh: 往西灣河或赤柱。

from_end.note_en: Sundays and public holidays only. To Siu Sai Wan or Stanley.
from_end.note_zh: 只在星期日及假日行駛，往小西灣或赤柱。

from_end.note_en: To Chai Wan MTR station.
from_end.note_zh: 往柴灣港鐵站。

routes.safety_en: Mostly paved and downhill. Tai Tam Road is busy: cross with care, and take care on the narrow Tai Tam Tuk dam road.
routes.safety_zh: 大部分為下坡車路。大潭道車多，過馬路要小心；在大潭篤水壩窄路拍照時注意車輛。

highlights_en: Ridge walk over Ma Tau Fung, Kai Tsai Tung and Tai Tung
Views of Plover Cove Reservoir, Double Haven and Tolo Channel
Finish across the 2 km main dam
highlights_zh: 走過馬頭峰、雞仔峒、大峒等山脊
俯瞰船灣淡水湖、印洲塘及赤門海峽
最後走過兩公里長的主壩
routes.water_en: No supply points on the whole trail. Carry plenty of water and food.
routes.water_zh: 全程沒有補給點，必須帶備足夠糧水。
routes.toilets_en: None on the trail. Toilets at Tai Mei Tuk.
routes.toilets_zh: 沿途沒有廁所；大美督設有公廁。
exits_en: From Wang Leng Au, path down to Wu Kau Tang
Before Tai Tung, path down via Ha Miu Tin to Wu Kau Tang
No official exits after Tai Tung: go on or turn back
exits_zh: 橫嶺坳可下走烏蛟騰
大峒前可經下苗田下走烏蛟騰
過大峒後沒有正式支路，只能前行或折返

to_start.note_en: To Wu Kau Tang terminus.
to_start.note_zh: 往烏蛟騰總站。

to_start.note_en: Sundays and public holidays only. Alight Bride's Pool terminus, walk to Wu Kau Tang.
to_start.note_zh: 只在星期日及假日行駛。於新娘潭總站下車，步行往烏蛟騰。

from_end.note_en: To Tai Po Market MTR station.
from_end.note_zh: 往大埔墟港鐵站。

from_end.note_en: To Tai Po Market MTR station.
from_end.note_zh: 往大埔墟港鐵站。

from_end.note_en: Sundays and public holidays only.
from_end.note_zh: 只在星期日及假日行駛。

routes.safety_en: AFCD rates it 5/5 (very difficult). Long, exposed ridge with no shade, and steep sections with loose gravel. Start early. High risk of heat stroke in hot weather.
routes.safety_zh: 漁護署評為五星（非常難行）。山脊路程長，全無樹蔭，部分路段碎石陡滑。請及早出發，天熱慎防中暑。

routes.name_en: High Island Geo Trail – East Dam Section
routes.name_zh: 萬宜地質步道 – 東壩段
highlights_en: S-shaped hexagonal rock columns (about 140 million years old)
Sea cave seen from the wooden boardwalk
Views of Po Pin Chau sea stack
highlights_zh: S形扭曲六角岩柱（約1億4千萬年前形成）
routes.water_en: No shops or supply points at East Dam. Bring water.
routes.water_zh: 東壩沒有商店或補給點，請自備食水。
routes.toilets_en: Public toilets at East Dam.
routes.toilets_zh: 東壩設有公廁。
exits_en: Walk back to the East Dam minibus terminus
exits_zh: 折返東壩小巴總站

to_start.note_en: To Pak Tam Chung (Sheung Yiu stop), then take GMB 9A.
to_start.note_zh: 往北潭涌（上窰站），再轉專線小巴9A。

to_start.from_en: Diamond Hill MTR (96R) / Sha Tin Central (289R)
to_start.from_zh: 鑽石山港鐵站（96R）／沙田市中心（289R）
to_start.note_en: Sat, Sun and public holidays only. To Pak Tam Chung.
to_start.note_zh: 只在星期六、日及假日行駛，往北潭涌。

to_start.note_en: Sat, Sun and public holidays only, about 09:30–18:40, every 15–20 min, about 24 min ride.
to_start.note_zh: 只在星期六、日及假日行駛，約09:30至18:40，每15至20分鐘一班，車程約24分鐘。

to_start.note_en: Taxis can drive to East Dam; private cars cannot pass the Pak Tam Chung barrier.
to_start.note_zh: 的士可直達東壩；私家車不能駛過北潭涌閘口。

from_end.note_en: To Pak Tam Chung. Sat, Sun and public holidays only, last about 19:00. Long queues on busy days.
from_end.note_zh: 往北潭涌，只在星期六、日及假日行駛，尾班約19:00。假日人多要排隊。

from_end.note_en: Wait at the East Dam pavilion taxi stand.
from_end.note_zh: 於東壩涼亭候車。

routes.safety_en: No shade: bring sun protection and water. Stay on paths and behind barriers; cliffs are weathered. On weekdays there is no minibus: it is a 9 km road walk from Sheung Yiu. Optional Po Pin Chau Section (2 km, 3/5 demanding) needs a free Klook booking on set dates, 5 Sep–7 Oct 2026, 9am–5pm.
routes.safety_zh: 全程無樹蔭，做好防曬並帶足食水。請沿步道行走，切勿跨越圍欄，崖邊岩石已風化。平日沒有小巴，由上窰步行要約9公里。可加走破邊洲段（2公里，三星費力），2026年9月5日至10月7日指定日子上午9時至下午5時須經Klook免費預約。

routes.name_en: Ping Chau Country Trail (Tung Ping Chau)
routes.name_zh: 平洲環島郊遊徑（東平洲）
routes.start_en: Tung Ping Chau Pier (Wong Ye Kok)
routes.end_en: Tung Ping Chau Pier (Wong Ye Kok)
highlights_en: Kang Lau Shek sea stacks (7–8 m)
Lung Lok Shui 'dragon back' rock band
Wave-cut platforms, Cham Keng Chau, and coral in the marine park
highlights_zh: 海蝕平台、斬頸洲及海岸公園珊瑚
routes.water_en: A few restaurants and shops near the pier and at Tai Tong. Bring cash.
routes.water_zh: 碼頭附近及大塘有數間食肆及士多，請帶現金。
routes.toilets_en: Public toilets near the pier (basic).
routes.toilets_zh: 碼頭附近有公廁（設施簡陋）。
exits_en: Cut back across the island to the pier from the villages
exits_zh: 可從村落橫過小島返回碼頭

to_start.route: Ma Liu Shui – Tung Ping Chau
to_start.note_en: Tsui Wah Ferry. Sat 09:00 and 15:30; Sun and public holidays 09:00 only. About 1.5 h. Return ticket HK$100. Book online a week ahead.
to_start.note_zh: 翠華船務。星期六09:00及15:30；星期日及假日只有09:00。船程約1.5小時，來回船票$100，可提前一星期網上訂票。

to_start.note_en: Walk to Ma Liu Shui Ferry Pier, or take a taxi.
to_start.note_zh: 步行往馬料水碼頭，或乘的士。

from_end.route: Tung Ping Chau – Ma Liu Shui
from_end.note_en: Only one sailing: 17:15, Sat, Sun and public holidays.
from_end.note_zh: 只有一班：星期六、日及假日17:15開出。

routes.safety_en: Only one ferry back (17:15). Miss it and you stay the night. No ferries on weekdays. Wave-cut platforms are passable only at low tide; rocks are slippery. Marine park: do not take shells, coral or rocks.
routes.safety_zh: 回程只有17:15一班船，錯過便要留宿。平日沒有船。海蝕平台只在潮退時才可通過，岩石濕滑。屬海岸公園範圍，切勿帶走貝殼、珊瑚或石頭。

highlights_en: Tombolo to Kiu Tau (walkable at low tide)
Viewpoint over Kau Sai Chau and Yim Tin Tsai
Hap Mun Bay beach
highlights_zh: 連島沙洲通往橋頭（潮退時可步行）
觀景點遠眺滘西洲及鹽田梓
routes.water_en: Small kiosks at Kiu Tsui and Hap Mun Bay beaches. Nothing on the trail.
routes.water_zh: 橋咀及半月灣泳灘設士多，山徑上沒有補給。
routes.toilets_en: Toilets and changing rooms at Kiu Tsui and Hap Mun Bay beaches.
routes.toilets_zh: 橋咀及半月灣泳灘設廁所及更衣室。
exits_en: Turn back to Kiu Tsui Pier
exits_zh: 折返橋咀碼頭

to_start.note_en: To Sai Kung town.
to_start.note_zh: 往西貢市中心。

to_start.note_en: To Sai Kung Pier.
to_start.note_zh: 往西貢碼頭。

to_start.note_en: Several operators (look for flags/signs). About 15 min. Weekdays about every 30 min; more often at weekends. Cash.
to_start.note_zh: 多間街渡公司（以旗號分辨），船程約15分鐘。平日約30分鐘一班，假日更密。多收現金。

from_end.note_en: Use the same operator as your return ticket. Last boat about 18:00–18:30.
from_end.note_zh: 須乘回來回票所屬公司的船。尾班船約18:00至18:30。

routes.safety_en: The tombolo is only walkable when the tide is below about 1.4 m; check HKO tide times and watch the rising tide. Confirm the last boat with your operator.
routes.safety_zh: 潮水低於約1.4米時才可步行連島沙洲，請查天文台潮汐並留意潮漲。請向街渡公司確認尾班船時間。

routes.start_en: Tai Mei Tuk (Country Park Management Centre)
routes.start_zh: 大美督（郊野公園管理站）
highlights_en: Views over Plover Cove Reservoir
Spring Breeze Pavilion, memorial to the 1996 Pat Sin Leng hill fire
Views of Tolo Harbour and Ma On Shan
highlights_zh: 春風亭（紀念1996年八仙嶺山火）
routes.water_en: Shops at Tai Mei Tuk. None on the trail.
routes.water_zh: 大美督有士多，沿途沒有補給。
routes.toilets_en: Tai Mei Tuk area. None on the trail.
routes.toilets_zh: 大美督一帶設公廁，沿途沒有。
exits_en: Turn back to Tai Mei Tuk
exits_zh: 折返大美督

to_start.note_en: To Tai Mei Tuk terminus, then walk about 10 min uphill on Bride's Pool Road.
to_start.note_zh: 往大美督總站，再沿新娘潭路上行約10分鐘。

to_start.note_en: To Tai Mei Tuk.
to_start.note_zh: 往大美督。

to_start.note_en: Sundays and public holidays only.
to_start.note_zh: 只在星期日及假日行駛。

from_end.note_en: To Tai Po Market MTR station.
from_end.note_zh: 往大埔墟港鐵站。

from_end.note_en: Sundays and public holidays only.
from_end.note_zh: 只在星期日及假日行駛。

from_end.note_en: Or walk back along Bride's Pool Road to Tai Mei Tuk.
from_end.note_zh: 或沿新娘潭路步行返回大美督乘車。

routes.safety_en: Part of the trail is closed after a landslide (AFCD notice); follow the signed detour. Long stone steps at the start. Hill fire risk: no fires.
routes.safety_zh: 部分路段因山泥傾瀉暫時封閉（漁護署通告），請按指示使用替代路徑。起段石級頗長。嚴防山火，切勿生火。

routes.start_en: Rotary Park, Tai Mo Shan Road
routes.end_en: Rotary Park, Tai Mo Shan Road
highlights_en: Short stone-paved forest loop
Viewpoint over Tsuen Wan and Tsing Yi
Schima blossom in spring; Sweet Gum turns red in winter
highlights_zh: 觀景台遠眺荃灣及青衣
春天木荷開花，冬天楓香轉紅
routes.water_en: No shops on the walk. Bring water.
routes.water_zh: 沿途沒有商店，請自備食水。
routes.toilets_en: Toilets and visitor centre in Tai Mo Shan Country Park.
routes.toilets_zh: 大帽山郊野公園設遊客中心及廁所。
exits_en: Walk back down Tai Mo Shan Road
exits_zh: 沿大帽山道回程

to_start.note_en: Alight Tai Mo Shan Country Park stop, then walk up Tai Mo Shan Road to Rotary Park.
to_start.note_zh: 於大帽山郊野公園站下車，沿大帽山道上行至扶輪公園。

from_end.from_en: Tai Mo Shan Country Park stop
from_end.note_en: Back to Tsuen Wan.
from_end.note_zh: 返回荃灣。

routes.safety_en: Very short (about 20–30 min). Fog is common; stay on the path. Schima bark is poisonous: do not touch.
routes.safety_zh: 路程很短（約20至30分鐘）。山上常有大霧，請沿路徑行走。木荷樹皮有毒，切勿觸摸。

highlights_en: Finger Hill summit pavilion, highest point of Peng Chau
Tung Wan beach
Old village lanes and temples
highlights_zh: 手指山頂涼亭（坪洲最高點）
routes.water_en: Restaurants and shops near the pier; kiosk at Tung Wan.
routes.water_zh: 碼頭附近有食肆及士多；東灣有士多。
routes.toilets_en: Public toilets in the village, including near the trail start.
routes.toilets_zh: 村內設公廁，包括郊遊徑起點附近。
exits_en: Many side paths lead back to the village
From Tung Wan, walk back to the pier
exits_zh: 多條支路可折返村內
由東灣可步行返回碼頭

to_start.note_en: HKKF, about 25–30 min. About every 30–50 min.
to_start.note_zh: 港九小輪，約25至30分鐘，約30至50分鐘一班。

to_start.note_en: Tsui Wah Ferry; some sailings via Trappist Monastery.
to_start.note_zh: 翠華船務，部分班次途經聖母神樂院。

from_end.note_en: HKKF to Central Pier 6. Last sailing about 23:30.
from_end.note_zh: 港九小輪往中環6號碼頭，尾班約23:30。

routes.safety_en: Many branch paths have no signs; carry a map. Watch for stray dogs on the steps east of Finger Hill.
routes.safety_zh: 很多支路沒有指示牌，請帶備地圖。手指山東面梯級一帶常有野狗，請留意。

routes.start_en: Tai Hang Tun, Clear Water Bay Road
highlights_en: Tai Leng Tung summit views over Port Shelter, Clear Water Bay and Po Toi O
Distant Ninepin Group
Lung Ha Wan rock carving, about 3,000 years old
highlights_zh: 大嶺峒山頂俯瞰牛尾海、清水灣及布袋澳
近3,000年歷史的龍蝦灣石刻
routes.water_en: Kiosk and BBQ site at Tai Hang Tun (start). None on the trail.
routes.water_zh: 起點大坑墩設小食亭及燒烤場，沿途沒有補給。
routes.toilets_en: Toilets at the country park picnic and BBQ areas.
routes.toilets_zh: 郊野公園野餐及燒烤地點設洗手間。
exits_en: Turn back to Tai Hang Tun
exits_zh: 折返大坑墩

to_start.note_en: Alight Tai Au Mun, then walk about 20 min along Clear Water Bay Road to Tai Hang Tun.
to_start.note_zh: 於大坳門站下車，沿清水灣道步行約20分鐘至大坑墩。

to_start.note_en: Alight Tai Au Mun.
to_start.note_zh: 於大坳門下車。

to_start.from_en: Kwun Tong Ferry Pier / Tseung Kwan O MTR
to_start.from_zh: 觀塘碼頭／將軍澳港鐵站
to_start.note_en: Alight Tai Au Mun.
to_start.note_zh: 於大坳門下車。

from_end.note_en: Walk about 30 min along Lung Ha Wan Road back to Tai Au Mun Road.
from_end.note_zh: 沿龍蝦灣路步行約30分鐘返回大坳門路乘車。

routes.safety_en: Steep stone steps at the start; exposed hilltop, so avoid hot midday hours. Do not climb near the cliff at the rock carving.
routes.safety_zh: 起段石級陡斜，山頂開揚無遮蔭，避免烈日當空時段。石刻位於崖邊，切勿攀爬。
